title: Export Management
description: Track and download export files requested from products, orders and mileage history.

queue_sync.title: Synchronous processing
queue_sync.message: The queue connection is sync, so exports run inside the request. Large exports may freeze the screen or fail with a timeout. Set up a queue worker in production.

storage_public.title: Public storage in use
storage_public.message: Export files are stored on a public disk. Anyone who knows a file URL can download it, so use this at your own risk. A private disk is recommended.

pending_stalled.title: Pending delay
pending_stalled.message: Some jobs have been Pending for more than 10 minutes. Check that the queue worker is running.

modal.title: Export {type}
modal.data_current_hint: Exports the columns shown in the list. Columns that combine several values are split into one column per value.
modal.personal_locked: Only operators with the personal data export permission can choose personal fields.
modal.scope_selected_hint: You can export up to {max} selected items at once.
modal.period_hint: The period can be at most one year.
modal.period_required_hint: A period is required for this export.
modal.period_defaulted: The list has no usable period (none, or longer than one year), so the last month up to today was filled in. You can change the dates.
modal.period_selected_hint: Selected items are exported regardless of period.
modal.include_totals: Add a totals row at the end
modal.reason_hint: You selected fields containing personal data. The reason is kept in the activity log and Export Management.
modal.estimate_unknown: Conditions changed. Recalculate the estimated row count.
modal.estimate_large: This is a large export and may take a while.
modal.requested: Export requested. You can track it and download the file in Export Management.
modal.requested_notice: Export requested. You will get a notification (bell) when the file is ready, and you can download it from the progress indicator above the list or from Export Management.
modal.period_current_unavailable: The list has no usable period (missing or longer than a year), so "List period" cannot be selected.
modal.estimate_empty: There are no rows to export. Try changing the period or filters.
modal.estimate_failed: The estimate cannot be calculated with these conditions. Fix the highlighted field and it will recalculate.

tracking.failed: The file could not be created

modal_delete.title: Delete export
modal_delete.message: This export job and its file will be deleted.
modal_delete.warning: Deleted files cannot be restored. Download history and activity logs are kept.

modal_bulk_delete.title: Delete selected
modal_bulk_delete.message: Delete {count} selected export jobs and their files.
modal_bulk_delete.message_one: Delete {count} selected export job and its file.
modal_bulk_delete.warning: Jobs that are processing or outside your permission scope are skipped. Deleted files cannot be restored.

modal_retry.title: Request again
modal_retry.message: Request a new export with the same conditions as the failed job.
modal_retry.hint: The snapshot time becomes now, so data changed since then is included.
modal_retry.reason_hint: Another operator requested this job and it contains personal data. Enter your own reason for requesting it again — it is kept in the activity log and Export Management.

messages.download_failed: Could not download the file. Refresh the list and try again.
